g.text: GALINI / L02 / SEC02 / Laundry lower / upper transfer
Named encounter section / adjacent architecture, explicit positions and a bounded review question
L

Spatial prediction
The lower undercroft is roofed at 3.7 m and feeds an
internal returning stair. Upper exit D03 reaches Press
frontage; D04 reaches the civic street through a 3 m-deep
gallery. The stair hole stays open over both flights and
its +2 landing.
Support / opposing response
The narrow east gallery separates the follower from an
immediate north-door trade. A player can withdraw down the
stair, but the lower entry is another potential opponent
front. The upper floor is not a scenic roof.
Affected: M04, I01, I02, I03, D01, D02, D03, D04, S1a,
S1b, H-L. Walk routes: R01, R07. All circles are body
centers, not measured camera poses.
Predicted body / eye / 90-degree horizontal FOV
F / follower: (22, 49, 3) / eye Z 4.674
O / opponent: (30, 48, 4) / eye Z 5.674
L02 / geometry prediction. Later capture each listed stance from both sides, include the follower, and inspect standing/crouched exposure plus all intermediate stair or ramp
positions. Roofs and slabs remain opaque. Movement openings and observation apertures are different contracts.
